map.输入前坡 g₁、后坡 g₂、曲线长 L 与距起点距离 x，求相对高程 y。: Enter the front gradient g1, back gradient g2, curve length L and distance from start x, and find the relative elevation y.

map.：坡1：起点 100m、+2%/100m；坡2：从 300m 处 110m、−3: : Gradient 1: start 100 m, +2%/100 m; gradient 2: from 300 m at 110 m, -3%/100 m. Intersection: 100 + 0.02x = 110 - 0.03(x-300), so 100 + 0.02x = 110 - 0.03x + 9, so 0.05x = 19, so x = 380 m and the elevation = 100 + 0.02 x 380 = 107.6 m.
map.：得交点后按竖曲线半径 R 设抛物线过渡，避免折角突变。: : Once the intersection is found, set a parabolic transition by the vertical curve radius R to avoid an abrupt angle.

map.是竖曲线顶点（变坡点）高程，纵断面设计与标高控制基准。: It is the elevation at the vertical curve apex (the grade change point), the datum for profile design and elevation control.
map.直接折角驾驶颠、排水差，用抛物线/R 圆顺过渡更平顺安全。: A direct angle makes driving bumpy and drainage poor; a parabolic or circular transition is smoother and safer.
